issues.description: The data type of the Person.birthday field is inconsistent between the template/problem specification and the solution. The problem statement and the template/common model define Person.birthday as java.time.LocalDate (used throughout the client UI and UML), but the solution's common Person model declares birthday as String. This mismatch breaks type-safety and would prevent the client code (which passes LocalDate objects to Person.setBirthday and expects LocalDate from Person.getBirthday) from compiling or behaving correctly.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Person.birthday type consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution's src/common/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java to use java.time.LocalDate for the birthday field (with corresponding getter/setter). This preserves the client-side usage (DatePicker and LocalDate) and matches the UML/problem specification. Alternatively, if String is intended, update the problem statement, template client code (PersonScene and controllers), and all usages to accept/convert Strings consistently.
